What it does

Joist is designed for the moment you are standing in front of a customer and need to put a number on the job. You build the estimate on a phone, send it for approval, and convert it into an invoice once the work is done. The AI element is thin — the real value is speed from quote to payment without going back to the office.

Where the AI actually is

Limited AI assistance — the core value is fast quoting and invoicing, not AI.

Pros

  • Genuinely usable free tier
  • Built around the trade workflow, not generic small business
  • Clients can approve quotes and pay from their phone

Cons

  • Less useful once you need crew scheduling and dispatch

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Remodelers & carpenters in mind. Solo contractors and small crews who mainly need to quote and get paid.
